title: The Hopf Algebraic Structure of Finitely Supported Currents on a Lie Group
summary: The space of de Rham currents supported in finitely many points in a Lie group $G$ has the structure of a filtered differential graded Hopf algebra. The product is given by convolution of compactly supported currents, and the co-product dualizes to wedge product on differential forms. This space arises as the finitely supported sections functor $ Γ^{finite} $ applied to the bundle $ \mathcal{U}(G) $ of currents on $ G $ supported at a single (variable) point, and the differential Hopf algebra operations pull back via $ Γ^{finite} $ to bundle maps.
